synthesis.headline: Management has abandoned key quantitative guidance, despite strong revenue growth and improved operational profitability.

points.text: Management dropped all specific quantitative targets for district losses, quick commerce CAGR, dark store counts, and steady-state margins after May 2026.
Annual revenue grew significantly to 54,364 crore in Mar 2026, while operating margins turned positive at 2.2% and PAT reached 366 crore.
Quarterly revenue reached 24,138 crore by Sep 2026 with margins expanding to 3.1%, reflecting improved operational efficiency despite the lack of forward guidance.

bull.text: Revenue scaled from 1,994 crore to 54,364 crore over five years, with operating margins turning positive since Mar 2024.
Strong cash flow generation with CFO/PAT ratios of 1.84 and 1.73 in recent years, alongside a low D/E ratio of 0.18.

bear.text: Management has ceased providing specific quantitative targets for growth and margins, reducing visibility into future performance.
ROCE remains low at 2.0% as of Sep 2026, despite the significant expansion in scale.
